label: default_tree_top
reference_prompt: Create a close material reference for the cut end-grain of a mature oak trunk from an old grounded dark-fantasy forest. Show slow accumulated growth through irregular but readable rings surrounding dense heartwood. The end-grain should carry small radial checks, subtle tannin-darkened zones, knots or growth disturbances and slightly rough exposed fibers. It has been cut, but it belongs to a weathered world rather than a modern lumber yard. Use subdued honey-brown sapwood around deeper muted brown heartwood. Avoid perfect concentric targets, polished butcher-block appearance, giant radial cracks or fresh glossy sap. Let the tree's age and changing seasons emerge through the grain. The reference should establish believable oak end-grain while leaving all final composition to the source texture.
